privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.description: This Privacy Policy explains what information we collect, how we use it, and your choices when using our services.

informationCollect.title: Information We Collect
informationCollect.content: We may collect account details, profile information, usage data, and technical data such as device type, browser, and IP address.

howWeUse.title: How We Use Information
howWeUse.content: We use information to provide and improve the service, authenticate users, process billing, communicate updates, and prevent abuse.

informationSharing.title: Information Sharing
informationSharing.content: We do not sell personal information. We may share data with trusted processors and partners only as needed to operate the service.

dataRetention.title: Data Retention
dataRetention.content: We retain personal data for as long as needed to provide services, meet legal obligations, resolve disputes, and enforce agreements.

security.title: Security
security.content: We apply reasonable technical and organizational safeguards to protect your data, but no system can guarantee absolute security.

cookies.title: Cookies and Similar Technologies
cookies.content: We use cookies and similar technologies to keep you signed in, remember preferences, analyze traffic, and improve product performance.

yourRights.title: Your Rights and Choices
yourRights.content: Depending on your region, you may request access, correction, deletion, portability, or restriction of your personal information.

contactUs.title: Contact Us
contactUs.content: If you have privacy questions or requests, contact our support team.

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.description: These Terms of Service govern your access to and use of our products and services.

accountResponsibilities.title: Account Responsibilities
accountResponsibilities.content: You are responsible for maintaining account security and for all activity under your account credentials.

acceptableUse.title: Acceptable Use
acceptableUse.content: You agree not to misuse the service, interfere with operations, violate laws, or attempt unauthorized access.

intellectualProperty.title: Intellectual Property

billingAndRefunds.title: Billing and Refunds
billingAndRefunds.content: Paid plans are billed according to selected terms. Unless required by law, fees are non-refundable after the billing cycle starts.

disclaimers.title: Disclaimers
disclaimers.content: The service is provided on an "as is" and "as available" basis without warranties of any kind, to the extent permitted by law.

liabilityLimit.title: Limitation of Liability
liabilityLimit.content: To the maximum extent permitted by law, we are not liable for indirect, incidental, or consequential damages.

termination.title: Termination
termination.content: We may suspend or terminate access if you materially breach these terms or use the service in a harmful manner.

changesToTerms.content: We may update these terms from time to time. Continued use after updates means you accept the revised terms.

contactUs.title: Contact Us
contactUs.content: For questions about these terms, please contact our support team.
